summary: Initial testing of SPICE profile setup workflow. Fixed critical Vite configuration issue blocking app access. App is now accessible and signup page loads correctly. Ready for comprehensive profile setup workflow testing.

configuration_issues.issue: Vite server was blocking requests from public URL due to missing allowedHosts configuration
configuration_issues.fix_applied: Added preview.emergentagent.com domain to allowedHosts in vite.config.ts
configuration_issues.impact: App was completely inaccessible from public URL

minor_issues.issue: SVG viewBox attribute errors in console: 'Unexpected end of attribute. Expected number, "0 0 24"'

passed_tests: ✅ App loads successfully on public URL
✅ Homepage renders correctly with SPICE branding
✅ Signup form displays all required fields
✅ Vite dev server running and accessible

success_percentage.backend: Not yet tested (Supabase-based, requires account creation)

items.description: The SPICE_PROFILE_SETUP_COMPLETE_MIGRATION.sql file needs to be applied to Supabase database. This migration adds all required fields for the 14-step profile setup workflow.
items.action: Execute this SQL migration in Supabase SQL Editor to create all necessary database columns and indexes

items.description: Testing agent needs to create test accounts and test the complete 14-step workflow for both Individual and Couple account types. This requires:
requirements: Valid Supabase credentials with database access
Test user accounts (or ability to create them)
Profile photos storage bucket configured in Supabase

items.description: Minor issue: SVG icons have malformed viewBox attributes. Search for SVG components with incomplete viewBox values and fix them.

testing_notes.environment: Vite dev server running on port 3000, accessible via public URL
testing_notes.architecture: React + Vite frontend, Supabase backend (auth, database, storage), Vercel serverless functions for API
testing_notes.testing_approach: Browser automation with Playwright for UI testing, Supabase queries for backend verification
testing_notes.limitations: Cannot fully test profile setup workflow without database migration applied and test accounts created
